pages.title: Ray tracing (graphics)
pages.extract:
In 3D computer graphics, ray tracing is a technique for modeling light transport.


== History ==
The idea of ray tracing comes from the 16th century, when artists studied the projection of a scene onto a surface.


== Algorithm ==
Ray tracing follows a path from an imaginary eye through each pixel in a virtual screen, and calculates the color of the object visible through it.
